build_shufflenet_backbone: build a ShufflenetBackbone instance from torchvision shufflenet_v2_x1_0 with pretrained ImageNet weights
build_shufflenet_fpn_backbone: build a ShuffleNet FPN backbone registered in detectron2 BACKBONE_REGISTRY with configurable FPN settings
run_forward_shufflenet: run the ShufflenetBackbone forward pass to extract multi-scale feature maps p2 through p6
review_shufflenet_out_features: review the ShufflenetBackbone output feature channels and strides for p2 to p6 pyramid levels
refactor_shufflenet_pretrain_logic: refactor the ImageNet pretrain detection logic in build_shufflenet_fpn_backbone to fix cfg weight comparison
